paper.title: Leveraging Offline Data in Linear Latent Contextual Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Linear latent contextual bandit with offline data (online regret)
unmapped: Offline dataset of N_off unlabeled trajectories of length H, each generated with its own reward parameter beta_n = U_* theta_n drawn from a latent distribution, collected by a behavior policy not depending on theta, with offline contexts i.i.d. independent of theta (Assumption 1)
Reward parameters lie in an unknown d_K-dimensional subspace of R^{d_A} (latent low-rank structure across users)
Coverage assumption: lambda_A = min_i lambda_min(E[D_{n,i}]) > 0 and lambda_theta = lambda_min(Lambda)/R^2 > 0
Learner knows d_K, d_A and the reward/parameter bound R
Regret measured for a single fixed online latent parameter beta_*
settings.definition_quote: A linear latent contextual bandit is a linear bandit equipped with a feature map ... $\phi: \gX \times \gA \to \Real^{d_A}$, a latent random variable $\btheta \in \Real^{d_K}$ ... $Y_h \mid \btheta \sim \phi(x_h,a_h)^\top \bbeta + \epsilon$ ... $\bbeta = \BU_\star \btheta$. Assumption 2: Rewards $|r_{n,h}| \leq R$, $\|\phi(x,a)\|_2 \leq 1$ and $\|\bbeta\|_2 \leq R$.

settings.name_in_paper: Linear latent bandit with offline data (lower bound)
unmapped: Learner additionally gets offline data: N_off trajectories of length H from a latent bandit F with rank-d_K latent subspace, generated by an arbitrary behavior policy
Reward parameters lie in a d_K-dimensional latent subspace of R^{d_A}
settings.definition_quote: Consider the action set $\gA = \{a \mid \|a\|_2 \leq 1\}$. ... there exists a family of tuples $(F, \bbeta)$, where $F$ is a latent bandit with a rank $d_K$ latent subspace and $\bbeta$ is a reward parameter in its support

settings.name_in_paper: Offline subspace estimation from latent bandit data (SOLD)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Purely offline estimation of a latent subspace from logged data (not interactive).
unmapped: Offline logged data from a behavior policy not depending on theta
Goal is estimating the projection onto the latent subspace in spectral norm
settings.definition_quote: we have access to a dataset $\gD_{\off}$ of $N$ trajectories ... of length $H$, collected by some behavior policy $\pi_b$.

algorithms.name: SOLD (Subspace estimation from Offline Latent bandit Data)

conditions: Assumption 1 (unconfounded offline actions, i.i.d. offline contexts)

source.label: thm:delta-off
source.quote: Then, with probability $1-\delta$, $\|\hat \BU \hat \BU^\top - \BU_\star \BU_\star^\top\|_2 \leq \Delta_{\off}$ ... Obtaining $\Delta_M$ and $\Delta_D$ from Propositions ..., $\Delta_{\off} = \widetilde O({\frac{1}{\lambda_\theta\lambda_A^3}N^{-1/2}}\sqrt{d_Kd_A\log(d_A/\delta)})$.

results.notes: Guarantee on the spectral-norm error of the estimated subspace projection. The theorem also gives an exact data-dependent expression for Delta_off in terms of Delta_M, Delta_D, B_D, hat lambda; only the rate is recorded.

tuning: alpha_{1,t} = R sqrt(mu) + C R sqrt(d_K log(2T/delta))
alpha_{2,t} = R sqrt(mu) + C R sqrt(d_A log(2T/delta))

source.label: thm:local-ucb
source.quote: Under Assumptions 1 and 2, if $\alpha_{1,t} = R\sqrt{\mu} + CR\sqrt{d_K\log(2T/\delta)}$ and $\alpha_{2,t} = ...$, then with probability at least $1-\delta$ over offline data and online rewards, LOCAL-UCB has regret $\Reg_T$ bounded by O(min(Rd_A\sqrt{T}, Rd_K\sqrt{T}(1 + \frac{1}{\lambda_\theta\lambda_A^3}\sqrt{\frac{Td_A}{d_KN}})))).

results.notes: Stated with O, but the proof shows log(T/delta) and log(d_A) factors are hidden (effectively O-tilde). Regret is defined via means against the per-round best action. Algorithm involves a nonconvex constraint; efficiency unclear.

conditions: action set is the unit l2 ball
holds for any offline behavior policy pi_b and any learner
lambda_theta uniformly bounded over the hard family

source.label: thm:regret-lower-bound
source.quote: Let $d_A^2H \leq 2T$, $d_A^2 \leq N$, $d_K > 1$. Consider the action set $\gA = \{a \mid \|a\|_2 \leq 1\}$. ... (ii) For any offline behavior policy $\pi_b$ and any learner, there is a $(F, \bbeta)$ such that the regret ... is bounded below by $\Omega(\min(d_A\sqrt{T}, d_K\sqrt{T}(1 + \sqrt{\frac{d_AT}{d_KN}})))$

results.notes: Informal version is printed as Theorem 1 in the main text. Remark says the contextual version has the same proof.

symbols.kappa_sq_avg: (1/S) sum_{t<=S} kappa_t^2, where S is the first step the projected branch is not played and kappa_t is the out-of-subspace leakage statistic

tuning: alpha_{1,t} = R sqrt(mu) + tau' R Delta_off kappa_t + C R sqrt(d_K log(T/delta))
alpha_{2,t} = R sqrt(mu) + C R sqrt(d_A log(T/delta))

source.label: thm:proball-ucb
source.quote: Let $\alpha_{1,t} = R\sqrt{\mu} + \tau'R\Delta_{\off}\kappa_t + CR\sqrt{d_K\log(T/\delta)}$ ... For $\tau = \tau' = 1$ we have that $\Reg_T = \widetilde O(\min(\Reg_{on,T}, \Reg_{hyb, T}))$ where $\Reg_{on,T} = Rd_A\sqrt{T}$ and $\Reg_{hyb,T} = Rd_K\sqrt{T}(1 + \frac{1}{\lambda_A^3\lambda_{\theta}}(\sqrt{\frac{d_AT}{d_KN}} + \sqrt{\frac{d_A}{SN}\sum_{t=1}^{S}\kappa_t^2}))$

results.notes: kappa_sq_avg is O(T^2) in the worst case but O(T) when all played features lie in the span of hat U (e.g. l2-ball feature sets), recovering the LOCAL-UCB rate. Probability level not explicitly stated in theorem but proof is with probability 1-delta.

cited_results.setting_description: Stochastic linear bandit with unit-ball action set in dimension d, Gaussian noise (Theorem 24.2)
